content: Classical QA systems face two main challenges related to question analysis and answer extraction. Several QA approaches were proposed in the literature for the open domain BIBREF16 , BIBREF17 and the medical domain BIBREF18 , BIBREF19 , BIBREF20 . A variety of methods were developed for question analysis, focus (topic) recognition and question type identification BIBREF21 , BIBREF22 , BIBREF23 , BIBREF24 . Similarly, many different approaches tackled document or passage retrieval and answer selection and (re)ranking BIBREF25 , BIBREF26 , BIBREF27 .
